content:
Customer says: 'Your system sent 4 duplicate invoices and charged us four times. Refund three charges.'

Case facts:
- Invoice table has one invoice: INV-771 for $240.
- Payment processor has one successful charge: CH-882 for $240.
- Email delivery log has four delivered invoice emails for INV-771 due to a notification retry bug.
- No duplicate charge ids exist.

Policy excerpts:
[P1] Duplicate notification emails are acknowledged as a communication defect but do not authorize refunds.
[P2] Duplicate charges are refunded after processor logs confirm multiple successful charges for the same invoice.
[P3] If financial logs contradict the customer claim, explain the verified records and offer to escalate if they can provide bank-statement evidence.

Resolve the case.
